about_the_game:
About This Game

Deep inside a rumbling volcano, light is your only ally and it’s always running out. Flarebound is a tactical roguelite where play unfolds in short bursts:

  • Move: Your miner dashes along the path you drew a moment ago.

  • Freeze: The world halts automatically - lava hangs, enemies pause, silence falls.

  • Plan in the Dark: In this calm pocket of time you can throw some of your limited flares and draw the next path for your miner. Or save your flares and draw blindly - but that can have serious consequences. 

  • Resume: Time snaps back to life and your miner commits to the path, for better or worse.

Each pause is a small puzzle: Will that flare reveal treasure, a wall of granite, or a waiting spider? Stretch the path to save precious seconds, or take shorter, safer steps and risk the lava’s advance. Helm-lamp upgrades, brighter bouncing flares, and path-length boosts become vital as you dig toward harsher biomes filled with snakes, skittering spiders, and stranger predators the deeper you go.

Earn coins, unlock permanent gear, learn how different creatures react to light—and try again.

Flarebound is being crafted by a one-person dad developer after work and kids’ bedtime, so every update is a labour of late-night love.

Wishlist if you’d like to follow the journey down into the dark.

Key Features

Draw-and-Go Movement
Trace tiles in darkness; your miner follows blindly.

Dynamic Flares
Upgrade burn time, radius, stickiness, bounces, pulses, infrared vision, and more.

Dripping Lava Pressure
Constant time limit keeps every choice tense.

Upgrade Doors
Upgrade your miner in each section; pick one of three run-defining perks.

Vault Rooms
Optional side gates unlocked by scarce keys: extra loot vs. valuable seconds.

Treasure Chests
Mid-segment rewards: flares, coins for meta-progression, or keys for vaults.

Pixel-Perfect Atmosphere
Retro 2D pixel art, dynamic lighting, and reactive soundscape.

One-More-Run Loop
Permanent upgrades, collectible fossils.

Roadmap to Release

Demo & Next Fest
Try the first volcano layer. Wishlist to get notified when it drops.

Early Access
Community-driven balancing, new biomes.

1.0 Launch
Complete the descent in many volcanoes, achievement set, trading cards.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD Radeon R7
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Requires a mouse

short_description: A tactical roguelike where you throw flares to briefly pierce the darkness, draw a path in pitch black, and race dripping lava following you through the volcanic tunnels. Plan fast, dig deep, and descend to the safe place before the lava swallows everything.
